blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/
blocks.zh: 直接政策世界行动模式(WAM)表明,将行动生成与明确的未来视觉预测脱钩的好处在于能够有效推断自主驾驶和体现控制。 但是,它们仍然需要数十个取消提名的步骤,才能达到竞争行动的质量,从而产生很大的延迟并阻碍实时部署。 仅仅减少去名步骤的数量,就会使非线性多步骤去名轨迹崩溃而变成粗糙的更新,严重地降低行动质量。 为了减少虚名步骤,同时促成实时行动生成,我们提出了一个有效的世界行动模式,其中一步步行动生成,即OSWAM,用于自主驱动和体现控制。 我们认为,正是在随机噪声初始化中缺乏结构化行动前兆,才迫使WAM通过迭代去诺来直接恢复连贯的行动序列. 因此,我们构筑了想象符号来初始化传播过程,提供物理前科和有行动条件的表述. 我们进一步引入带有未来条件的特权信息分解,以增进未来意识的行动生成。 因此,OSWAM能够在仅仅一个传播步骤中高效而有效地产生出高质量的行动. 我们的实验表明,与直接政策WAM和联合WAM相比,OSWAM在自主驱动和体现控制方面都取得了相当甚至更好的结果,这需要数十个步骤。 它在直接政策WAM基线上获得约3\times美元的速度,并支持在NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU上低至40ms的实时编译推论. 项目网页见https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Physical intelligence [ 1 , 2 ] , including autonomous driving [ 3 ] and embodied control [ 4 ] , holds the promise of freeing human workers from physical tasks that are dangerous, laborious, or tedious.
A general-purpose physical agent should not only act from visual observations, but also anticipate the physical consequences of their actions.
Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, including those standard models [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] and specialized end-to-end ones [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , typically predict actions directly without explicitly modeling the future evolution of the environment.
This has motivated a shift toward World Action Models (WAMs) [ 4 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] for physical AI, which build on pretrained video generative models [ 14 , 15 ] to jointly predict future visual states and their corresponding actions.
blocks.zh:
身体智能[1,2],包括自主驾驶[3]和体现的控制[4],有使人类工人免于危险、劳累或乏味的体力工作的承诺。
通用物理剂不仅应当从视觉观察中行动,而且还应当预见其行动的实际后果.
现有的愿景-语言-行动模型,包括那些标准模型[5、6、7]和专门的端对端模型[8、9、10],通常在没有明确模拟未来环境演变的情况下直接预测行动。
这促使人们转向世界行动模式[4、11、12、13],用于物理AI,该模式以经过预先训练的视频基因模型[14、15]为基础,共同预测未来的视觉状态及其相应的行动。

blocks.en:
However, WAMs follow the imagine-then-execute paradigm [ 16 , 12 ] and incur prohibitive inference latency, rendering them impractical for latency-critical applications such as autonomous driving.
Borrowing few-step techniques from image and video generation, some methods apply step distillation [ 17 ] to reduce this latency, but often at the expense of a substantial drop in control accuracy, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
To address this issue, efforts [ 4 , 11 ] propose to switch from the imagine-then-execute paradigm to direct-policy WAMs. 
These methods retain video prediction as a training-time objective that shapes physically grounded representations, without synthesizing future observations at test time.
This direct-policy formulation is more than 3 × 3\times faster than the imagine-then-execute paradigm.
blocks.zh:
然而,WAMs遵循了当时的想象执行模式[16,12],并产生令人无法忍受的推论延迟,使其对于诸如自主驾驶等耐久关键应用不切实际.
一些方法从图像和视频生成中借用几步技术,采用步式蒸馏法[17]来减少这种延迟,但往往牺牲控制精度的大幅下降,如图1所示。
为了解决这一问题,努力[4,11]提议从设想中的执行范式转向直接政策WAM。
这些方法保留了视频预测作为训练时间的目标,它塑造了实体化的表达方式,而不在测试时间合成未来的观测.
这种直接政策的制定速度比想象中的执行模式要快3×3×次以上.

blocks.zh: 图 2: 将快速WAM[4]测试时间缩放与(a)自主驱动数据集Navsim上的不同动作解码步骤进行定量比较,(b) 包含控制数据集RoboTwin。

blocks.en:
Despite this speedup, efficiently generating high-quality actions remains a key challenge for direct-policy WAMs.
They require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, resulting in latency that remains too high for real-time applications such as autonomous driving.
This bottleneck cannot be resolved by reducing the number of denoising steps.
Specifically, as shown in Fig. 2 , the performance degrades as the step count decreases, dropping by 20 % 20\% on NAVSIM (autonomous driving) and 40 % 40\% on RoboTwin (embodied control) in the one-step setting.
We attribute this to the lack of action structure in random noise: multiple denoising steps can gradually impose temporal and physical consistency, whereas one-step generation must recover a coherent action sequence in a single update.
Existing few-step accelerations, such as step distillation [ 17 ] and trajectory rectification [ 18 ] , still start from Gaussian noise and, therefore, do not supply the missing action prior.
This motivates introducing structured action priors at initialization, providing an informed starting point for high-quality action generation in a single denoising step.
blocks.zh:
尽管速度加快,但有效开展高质量行动仍然是直接政策性WAM的关键挑战。
它们要求采取数十个取消提名的步骤,以实现竞争性行动的质量,从而造成对于自主驾驶等实时应用来说仍然太高的延迟。
这一瓶颈无法通过减少取消提名的步骤来解决。
具体地说,如图2所示,性能随着步数的减少而下降,在NAVSIM(自主驾驶)上下降了20%,在单步状态下下降了40%,在RoboTwin(健全控制)上下降了40%。
我们将此归因于随机噪声中缺乏动作结构:多个调音步骤可以逐渐强制时间和物理上的一致性,而一步代则必须在一次更新中恢复一个连贯的动作序列.
现有的几步加速度,如步蒸馏[17]和轨迹校正[18],仍然从高斯噪音开始,因此不提供之前缺失的动作.
这促使在初始化时引入结构化行动前缀,为在单一的去诺化步骤中产生高质量的行动提供了一个知情的起点.

blocks.en:
In addition, direct-policy WAMs [ 4 , 11 ] remain limited in their ability to exploit future dynamics for effective control.
They use a consistent first-frame-only interface during training and inference, relying on video co-training to encode future dynamics into the current representation.
However, compressing all future information into a single first-frame representation may provide insufficient temporal context for effective future-aware control.
To address this limitation, subsequent methods reintroduce future features at inference and mitigate the associated rollout cost through caching, sparse interaction [ 19 ] , or compact latent representations [ 20 ] .
Despite these efforts to reduce rollout cost, generating and incorporating future features at test time still incurs additional inference overhead.
blocks.zh:
此外,直接政策WAM[4,11]在利用未来动态进行有效控制的能力方面仍然有限.
他们在培训和推论期间使用一致的仅限第一帧的界面,依靠视频协同训练,将未来的动态编码为目前的表示.
然而,将所有未来信息压缩为单一的第一个框架表述可能为有效的未来认知控制提供足够的时间背景。
为了解决这一限制,随后的方法通过缓冲、零散的相互作用[19]或紧凑的潜在表述[20],重新提出今后的特点,并减轻相关的推出成本。
尽管为降低推出成本作出了这些努力,但在试验时产生和纳入未来特征仍会产生额外的推论间接费用。

blocks.en:
To address the aforementioned issues, we propose OSWAM , a world action model with one-step action generation for more effective physical control.
Our key observation is that previous one-step action generation methods fail mainly because the action diffusion processing is initialized from unstructured Gaussian noise.
To supply the missing action structure, we learn a compact set of imagination tokens from the video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) and use them as structured start points for action denoising.
These tokens are far fewer than video first-frame tokens and are obtained in a single forward pass, so they add negligible computation, yet they interact with visual features to accumulate physically grounded, action-relevant context.
We then noise the imagination tokens to an intermediate timestep and decode them with the action DiT in one step, replacing the long denoising trajectory required by random initialization.
To enhance future-aware control, we train these imagination tokens with privileged-information distillation.
A teacher attends to visual tokens over the full future horizon, while the student imagination tokens, at test time, attend only to the first frame.
By distilling the teacher’s privileged representations into the imagination tokens and subsequently into the action DiT, OSWAM transfers long-horizon context without reintroducing future-dependent features at inference.
This design preserves the first-frame-only interface of direct-policy WAMs, while enabling high-quality action generation in a single denoising step.
blocks.zh:
为了解决上述问题,我们提议OSWAM, 一种世界行动模式,
我们的关键观察是,之前的一步动作生成方法失败主要是因为动作扩散处理是从无结构的高斯噪音中初始化的.
为了提供缺失的动作结构,我们从视频Difusion Transformer(DiT)中学习了一套紧凑的想象符号,并将它们作为结构化的起步点来进行动作解析.
这些代币远少于视频第一帧代币,是在一次前传中获得的,因此它们添加了可忽略不计的计算,然而它们与视觉特征相互作用,以积累实际的,与动作相关的上下文.
然后把想象符号噪音到中间时间步 用一步中的DiT来解码, 取代随机初始化所需的长期去诺化轨迹。
为了增强未来意识的控制,我们用特权信息提炼来训练这些想象符号.
老师在全未来视野上关注视觉符号,而学生想象符号在测试时只关注第一帧.
OSWAM通过将老师的特权表达方式提炼成想象符号,然后再提入动作DiT,转移了长视野背景,而不在推论中重新引入未来依赖性特征.
这种设计保留了直接政策WAM的仅限第一帧的界面,同时使高品质的动作生成在单一的解析步骤中得以实现.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose OSWAM, a world action model that enables high-quality one-step action generation.
It learns compact imagination tokens from the video DiT as structured start points for the action DiT.
These tokens are obtained in a single forward pass with negligible overhead and are decoded in one denoising step. • We introduce privileged-information distillation to transfer long-horizon context into the imagination tokens.
A teacher attends to visual tokens over the full future horizon, while the student remains first-frame-only at test time, preserving the interface of direct-policy WAMs without future-dependent features at inference. • Experiments on autonomous driving and embodied control show that OSWAM achieves competitive results with multi-step WAMs while being substantially faster.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: 2.1 自主驾驶世界行动模式

blocks.en:
Autonomous driving has recently shifted from modular pipelines with separate perception [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] and planning [ 25 ] modules toward end-to-end frameworks [ 26 ] .
To further integrate future dynamics modeling, world models [ 14 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] for autonomous driving have recently been extended into world action models (WAMs).
Existing methods fall into two categories: bird’s-eye view (BEV)-based and video-generation-based world models.
BEV-based approaches [ 10 , 30 , 31 ] forecast occupancy evolution and ego motion, predict future latent scene features, or infer future BEV layouts for online trajectory evaluation.
They are computationally efficient but do not exploit large-scale video generative priors.
A complementary line of research leverages pretrained video generators and predicts the future in the image domain.
These methods [ 32 , 13 , 33 ] transfer such priors to driving, but jointly rolling out video features at test time remains inefficient.
SimWAM [ 11 ] follows the direct-policy design of Fast-WAM [ 4 ] to avoid test-time video rollout, yet the remaining multi-step denoising is still impractical for onboard driving.
In contrast, our proposed OSWAM inherits large-scale video generative priors without test-time video rollout, and reduces action generation to a single denoising step.
blocks.zh:
自主驾驶最近从具有单独认知[21、22、23、24]和规划[25]个模块的模块转向端到端框架[26]。
为了进一步整合未来的动态模型,最近将自主驱动的世界模型[14、27、28、29]扩展为世界行动模型。
现有方法分为两类:鸟眼观(BEV)和视频生成世界模型.
基于BEV的方法 [10, 30, 31] 预测占用的演变和自我运动,预测未来潜在的场景特征,或者推断未来BEV的布局用于在线轨迹评价.
它们具有计算效率,但不利用大规模视频基因学前科。
互补的一行研究利用了预先训练的视频生成器,并预测了图像领域的未来.
这些方法[32,13,33]将这种前科转移给驾驶,但在测试时联合推出的视频功能仍然效率低下.
SimWAM [11] 遵循了Fast-WAM [4] 的直接政策设计,以避免测试时间视频推出,然而剩下的多步解禁对于机上驾驶仍然不切实际.
相反,我们提出的OSWAM继承了大规模视频基因前科,而没有测试时间视频推出,并将动作生成减少为单一的去诺化步骤.

blocks.en: 2.2 World Action Models for Embodied Control
blocks.zh: 2.2 健全控制世界行动模式

blocks.en:
Unlike autonomous driving, where compact BEV representations naturally encode road topology and traffic interactions, embodied control needs to model fine-grained object interactions and appearance changes in close-range scenes.
As these phenomena are naturally captured in video, embodied WAMs are predominantly built on pretrained video generators for image-domain future modeling in two ways: explicit future imagination and direct-policy inference.
Explicit-imagination methods [ 12 , 16 ] generate future visual representations at test time to guide action prediction, incurring substantial rollout latency.
Direct-policy WAMs [ 4 ] retain video prediction as a training signal but generate actions directly from current observations, avoiding test-time visual rollout; however, its iterative action denoising remains a bottleneck for high-frequency closed-loop control.
In contrast, OSWAM preserves large-scale video-generative priors without test-time visual rollout and reduces action generation to a single denoising step.
blocks.zh:
与自主驾驶不同,紧凑的BEV代表自然编码道路地形和交通互动,包含的控制需要在近距离场景中模拟精细的物体互动和外观变化.
由于这些现象自然在视频中捕捉到,体现的WAM主要建立在经过预先训练的视频生成器上,用于图像领域的未来建模,有两种方式:清晰的未来想象力和直接的政策推论.
清晰的想象方法[12,16]在测试时产生未来的视觉表现,以指导动作预测,产生大量推出的延时性.
直接政策 WAMs [4] 保留视频预测作为训练信号,但直接从当前观测中产生动作,避免测试时的视觉推出;然而,其迭代动作去诺仍然是高频闭路控制的一个瓶颈.
相比之下,OSWAM保留了大规模视频生成前科,没有测试时的视觉推出,并将动作生成减少为单一的去诺化步骤.

blocks.en: 2.3 Effective World Action Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 有效的世界行动模式

blocks.en:
The main deployment bottleneck for WAMs lies in the high computational cost of diffusion-based video and action generators, whose test-time latency is prohibitive for onboard driving and closed-loop manipulation.
Drawing one-step distillation from video generation, Flash-WAM [ 17 ] compresses joint video-action diffusion to a single denoising step per modality, but still synthesizes future video at inference.
Fast-WAM [ 4 ] removes test-time video rollout by predicting actions from current observations only, yet retains iterative action denoising.
Light-WAM [ 34 ] further replaces the generative action expert with a lightweight fusion head for single-pass action prediction, but underperforms on challenging benchmarks such as RoboTwin.
SimWAM [ 11 ] follows Fast-WAM to drop test-time video rollout, but its multi-step action denoising keeps inference latency well above the budget required for onboard deployment.
Building on this video-rollout-free direct-policy formulation, OSWAM addresses the remaining action-generation bottleneck through one-step action denoising.
blocks.zh:
WAMs的主要部署瓶颈在于基于扩散的视频和动作发电机的高昂计算成本,其测试时间延迟对于机上驾驶和闭路操纵来说是令人无法接受的.
从视频生成中画出一步蒸馏,Flash-WAM[17]压缩联合视频-动作传播到每个模式的单一去诺化步骤,但仍在推论中合成未来的视频.
Fast-WAM [4] 通过只从当前观测中预测动作来删除测试时间视频的推出,然而保留迭代动作代号.
Light-WAM [34] 进一步用轻量级聚变头取代了基因动作专家,用于单传动作预测,但在RoboTwin等具有挑战性的基准上表现不佳.
西姆[11]: 快速WAM可以放弃测试时间视频推出,但其多步动作去诺,使得推论延迟性远高于机上部署所需的预算.
在这种无视频推出的直接政策制定的基础上,OSWAM通过一步步的解禁行动来解决剩余的行动生成瓶颈.

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We present OSWAM, a direct-policy world action model that enables high-quality one-step action generation for autonomous driving and embodied control.
The preliminary concepts associated with our method are provided in Sec. 3.1 . In the following sections, we first present the overall architecture of OSWAM, then describe in detail the fundamental components of OSWAM, including imagination tokens, Role-aware 3D RoPE, and privileged-information distillation.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 总体结构

blocks.en:
An overview of OSWAM is shown in Fig. 3 .
As in previous works [ 4 , 11 ] , we consider predicting an action chunk 𝐚 1 : H \mathbf{a}_{1:H} from the current frame f 0 f_{0} and an optional task instruction l l , with ego-state information additionally provided for driving tasks.
We follow Fast-WAM in the world model backbone configuration and direct-policy setting.
Specifically, the Video DiT uses the Wan2.2-5B backbone [ 14 ] , accompanied by its pretrained T5 text encoder and video VAE.
The Action DiT is initialized by interpolating and downsampling the pretrained Video DiT weights.
For autonomous driving, we add an ego encoder to encode the ego state and the driving command.
The task languages and ego states are both provided to all tokens through cross-attention.
The full model is organized as a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture with shared attention between the video and action blocks.
We also follow the direct-policy protocol: video modeling is used only as a training signal, and future video is not rolled out at inference.

具体来说,Video DiT使用Wan2.2-5B主干线[14],并配有其预训的T5文本编码器和视频VAE.
动作DiT通过插图和下取样预训视频DiT重量来初始化.
对于自主驾驶,我们加了一个自我编码器来编码自我状态和驱动命令.
任务语言和自我状态都通过交叉注意提供给所有符号.
完整的模型被组织为一个Mixture-of-Transformer(MOT)架构,视频和动作块之间有共同的注意力.
我们还遵循直接政策协议:视频建模仅用作训练信号,未来视频不会推论推出.

blocks.en:
Unlike prior direct-policy methods, which use the Video DiT at inference solely to encode the first-frame visual feature for Action DiT through shared MoT attention, OSWAM additionally introduces two groups of imagination tokens into the Video DiT: Action Imagination Tokens (AIT) and Scene Imagination Tokens (SIT).
As shown in Fig. 3 , both AIT and SIT are initialized from noise in the Video DiT and interact with the first-frame visual features.
The resulting AIT representation then replaces the unstructured Gaussian initialization of the Action DiT, providing a compact, structured start point for action denoising.
SIT provides additional latent slots that aggregate scene context for AIT; they are updated indirectly through privileged distillation and the auxiliary action loss on AIT.
Together, AIT and SIT comprise far fewer tokens than the first-frame visual input and therefore introduce only a small computational overhead during inference.
To strengthen future-aware control under this first-frame-only interface, we introduce privileged-information distillation.
The privileged teacher comprises a Video DiT with AIT that attends to visual tokens over the full clip, while the AIT in OSWAM attends only first-frame visual context.
By aligning OSWAM’s intermediate imagination token features with those of the teacher, we transfer this privileged information to improve action generation, while OSWAM remains first-frame-only at inference.

blocks.en: 3.4 Privileged-Information Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.4 保密信息分离

blocks.en:
Although imagination tokens provide a structured action prior, long-horizon context is only implicitly encoded in the first-frame representation.
We therefore introduce privileged-information distillation to transfer representations learned from privileged future observations into OSWAM’s AIT, strengthening their predictive capability without requiring future observations at inference.
blocks.zh:
虽然想象符号提供了一种结构化的先行行动,但长视野上下文只是隐含在第一个框架的表示中.
因此,我们采用特权信息提炼法,将从特权未来观察中吸取的表述转移到OSWAM的AIT中,加强它们的预测能力,而无需今后在推论中进行观察。

blocks.en:
We separately train a Video DiT teacher with auxiliary AIT, following the same training settings as OSWAM except for the token groups and attention masks.
As shown in Fig. 4 (a), the teacher contains video tokens and AIT, with AIT attending to the full video clip.
OSWAM additionally includes SIT, and its AIT attends to first-frame visual tokens, SIT, and other AIT, while SIT attends only to first-frame visual tokens and other SIT.

我们单独训练一名带辅助AIT的Video DiT老师,
如图4(a)所示,该教师载有录像信使和AIT,AIT负责完整录像片段。
OSWAM还包含SIT,其AIT关注第一帧视觉符号,SIT,以及其他AIT,而SIT只关注第一帧视觉符号和其他SIT.

blocks.en:
During distillation, we freeze the teacher and provide it with ground-truth video latents over the full future horizon.
The first-frame latents remain clean, while all future-frame latents are corrupted with noise at a fixed diffusion timestep τ v T \tau_{v}^{T} before the teacher forward pass.
The teacher’s AIT remains initialized from pure noise at t max t_{\max} and acquires privileged information by attending to these future video tokens.
OSWAM retains its standard training procedure, using a randomly sampled video timestep and the fixed AIT timestep t max t_{\max} .
The teacher and OSWAM share the same video noise and action noise samples, respectively.
We then align OSWAM’s AIT features with the corresponding teacher features at a set of Video DiT blocks 𝒥 \mathcal{J} , providing multi-depth distillation supervision.
SIT is supervised indirectly through their attention connections to AIT.
At inference, the teacher is discarded, preserving OSWAM’s first-frame-only interface without additional computation.

blocks.zh: 3.5 培训目标

blocks.en:
OSWAM jointly learns visual dynamics, structured action DiT start points, and one-step action denoising.
The Video DiT is supervised by video flow matching, while its AIT representations receive complementary action and privileged feature supervision to learn the structured initialization consumed by the Action DiT: ℒ vid = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ‖ 𝐯 ^ V − ( ϵ V − 𝐳 + ) ‖ 2 2 ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vid}}=\mathbb{E}\bigl[\|\hat{\mathbf{v}}^{V}-(\boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{V}-\mathbf{z}^{+})\|_{2}^{2}\bigr], (8) where 𝐳 + \mathbf{z}^{+} denotes clean future video latents and ϵ V \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{V} is the video noise.
To learn an observation-conditioned action prior, the AIT decoder is supervised with the action velocity target at t max t_{\max} : ℒ AIT = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ‖ 𝐯 ^ A − ( ϵ − 𝐚 gt ) ‖ 2 2 ] . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AIT}}=\mathbb{E}\bigl[\|\hat{\mathbf{v}}^{A}-(\boldsymbol{\epsilon}-\mathbf{a}_{\mathrm{gt}})\|_{2}^{2}\bigr]. (9) Privileged feature distillation further guides the prior by aligning the OSWAM’s AIT representations with teacher across the selected blocks 𝒥 \mathcal{J} : ℒ dist = | 𝒥 | − 1 ​ 𝔼 ​ [ ∑ j ∈ 𝒥 ‖ 𝐡 j stu − sg ⁡ ( 𝐡 j tea ) ‖ 2 2 ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dist}}=|\mathcal{J}|^{-1}\mathbb{E}\bigl[\sum\nolimits_{j\in\mathcal{J}}\|\mathbf{h}^{\mathrm{stu}}_{j}-\operatorname{sg}(\mathbf{h}^{\mathrm{tea}}_{j})\|_{2}^{2}\bigr], (10) where 𝐡 j stu \mathbf{h}^{\mathrm{stu}}_{j} and 𝐡 j tea \mathbf{h}^{\mathrm{tea}}_{j} denote corresponding AIT features after block j j . Together, ℒ AIT \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AIT}} and ℒ dist \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dist}} support learning an observation-conditioned structured initialization for the Action DiT.
Given 𝐚 τ r init \mathbf{a}^{\mathrm{init}}_{\tau_{r}} constructed from the AIT prediction, the Action DiT learns to predict the demonstrated action chunks in one denoising step: ℒ act = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ‖ 𝐯 ^ act − σ r − 1 ​ ( 𝐚 τ r init − 𝐚 gt ) ‖ 2 2 ] . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{act}}=\mathbb{E}\bigl[\|\hat{\mathbf{v}}^{\mathrm{act}}-\sigma_{r}^{-1}(\mathbf{a}^{\mathrm{init}}_{\tau_{r}}-\mathbf{a}_{\mathrm{gt}})\|_{2}^{2}\bigr]. (11) Scaling the action residual by σ r − 1 \sigma_{r}^{-1} ensures that one Euler update with step size σ r \sigma_{r} directly moves 𝐚 τ r init \mathbf{a}^{\mathrm{init}}_{\tau_{r}} to the ground-truth action 𝐚 gt \mathbf{a}_{\mathrm{gt}} .
The overall objective is: ℒ = ℒ vid + ℒ AIT + λ dist ​ ℒ dist + ℒ act . \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vid}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AIT}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{dist}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dist}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{act}}. (12)

blocks.en:
Autonomous Driving. For autonomous driving, we evaluate OSWAM on the NAVSIM [ 43 ] , which provides real-world driving data sampled at 2Hz, with eight cameras covering a 360-degree
field of view and LiDAR observations.
The dataset comprises 1192 scenarios for training and 136 scenarios for testing.
NAVSIM introduces practical and reliable metrics that effectively bridge open-loop and closed-loop evaluation.
Specifically, NAVSIM evaluates model performance using the Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS), which is calculated based on five factors: No At-Fault Collision (NC), Drivable Area Compliance (DAC), Time-to-Collision (TTC), Comfort (Comf.), and Ego Progress (EP). We report PDMS, which is calculated as PDMS = NC × DAC × ( 5 × EP + 5 × TTC + 2 × C ) / 12 . \mathrm{PDMS}=\mathrm{NC}\times\mathrm{DAC}\times({5\times\mathrm{EP}+5\times\mathrm{TTC}+2\times\mathrm{C}})/{12}.

blocks.en: Effectiveness of Each Component. To more clearly illustrate the effectiveness of the different components in OSWAM, we conduct experiments by adding each of them to a baseline, which is set to one-step Fast-WAM. As shown in Table 5 , AIT substantially improves performance across both benchmarks, raising NAVSIM PDMS from 71.04 71.04 to 89.81 89.81 , and increasing RoboTwin success rates from 57.38 % 57.38\% to 87.42 % 87.42\% under Clean settings and from 55.80 % 55.80\% to 88.16 % 88.16\% under Randomized settings. The gains demonstrate the importance of structured start points for one-step action generation. Besides, privileged-information distillation further improves PDMS to 89.96 89.96 and RoboTwin success rates to 89.42 % 89.42\% and 89.62 % 89.62\% , without increasing inference latency. Finally, incorporating SIT yields the best performance on both benchmarks, demonstrating the complementary benefit of aggregating scene context for learning effective action priors.

We further evaluate OSWAM on a PiPER robotic arm using two real-world tabletop manipulation tasks: placing a packaged bread into a bowl and placing a board eraser into an open drawer. blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we presented OSWAM, an efficient world-action model for one-step action generation.
To address the reliance of direct-policy WAMs on iterative action denoising, we introduced Action Imagination Tokens to learn a structured initialization, supported by Scene Imagination Tokens that aggregate complementary scene context.
We further developed privileged-information distillation to transfer full future context into the Action Imagination Tokens.
Together, these designs enable action generation with a single Video DiT pass and one Action DiT denoising step.
Experiments on NAVSIM and RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrated the competitive planning and manipulation performance of OSWAM and its substantial latency reductions over direct-policy baselines.
OSWAM offers a practical approach to efficient world-action modeling for latency-critical control.

在本文中,我们介绍了OSWAM,这是一步骤行动一代的有效世界行动模式。
为了解决直接政策WAM对迭代动作的依赖,我们引入了Action Imagination Tokens来学习一个结构化的初始化,辅以Scene Imagination Tokens来汇总互补场景背景.
我们进一步发展了特权信息提炼,以便将未来的全部背景转移到行动想象托肯斯。
这些设计加在一起,可以使动作生成具有一个单Video DiT通过和一个Action DiT调制步骤.
关于NAVSIM和RoboTwin 2.0的实验表明OSWAM的竞争性规划和操纵性能,以及它相对于直接政策基线的大幅度延迟削减。
OSWAM提供了一种切实可行的方法,用以为延迟关键控制制定有效的世界行动模式。

Extending scene-context conditioning and privileged supervision to the action expert is a promising direction for future work.

Navsim v2. Compared with Navsim v1, Navsim v2 introduces the Extended Predictive Driver Model Score (EPDMS).
EPDMS incorporates Driving Direction Compliance (DDC), Traffic Light Compliance (TLC), Lane Keeping (LK), and Extended Comfort (EC), while extending the original comfort metric to History Comfort (HC).
As shown in Table A.1 , OSWAM achieves the highest EPDMS of 90.3 90.3 among the compared planners with only one action denoising step.
It slightly surpasses SimWAM 90.2 90.2 and outperforms Metis 89.5 89.5 , both of which require ten action denoising steps.
These results further demonstrate the effectiveness of OSWAM under more comprehensive evaluation criteria encompassing safety, traffic-rule compliance, and driving comfort.

Figure B.1 compares SimWAM and OSWAM under the one-step action generation setting.
SimWAM struggles to produce smooth trajectories, particularly when turning or navigating complex interactions with surrounding agents, leading to drivable-area violations and at-fault collisions.
In contrast, OSWAM handles these challenging examples with a single action denoising step, producing smoother trajectories while satisfying both no-at-fault collision and drivable-area compliance criteria.
Together with the real-time inference speed reported in Table 3 , these results highlight the potential of OSWAM for practical deployment in autonomous driving.
